payload.summary: Inside-out evidence: ticket resolve writes one roadmap.ticket-resolved event with canonical id/ts/seq/type/actor plus a sequence payload containing the full resolved ticket record and decision observation record/body. Ticket frontmatter durably keeps id,map,type,state,decision,resolution,blockers,human_only,created,updated; ticket distill empties only the question body. The decision observation keeps name=decision-<ticket>, created, tags=[decision,type], sources=[resolution event,...cited event ids], and body=decision first line + destination + full question + rationale. Journal compaction only adds observations and distilled marker files: it never edits/deletes archived events, and readJournal ignores markers and still reads active+archive. Live store: 23 resolved tickets; all 23 resolution events and source-linked decision observations found; one ticket body already distilled; all 23 resolution events archived; 18 extra source refs across 15 decisions, all present, spanning 17 notes and one other resolution event with heterogeneous arbitrary payload keys. Resolver actor is available only on the resolution event: all 23 live resolutions are agent-attributed, zero cite a human-attributed event, despite some agent notes claiming to relay human choices. The validator defines provable DD6 delegation as an agent resolution citing a human-attributed source; post-hoc ratification is a later human logged note carrying exact payload.ticket. Different-agent cited sources exist for two decisions, but no typed field proves a cross-agent grill rather than research. Recommendations: include resolved tickets only as decision rows; use exact resolution actor as deciding actor; derive only provable additive provenance facts (direct human resolver, agent resolver, cited-human delegation, later human ratification, incomplete), keep ticket type separate, and do not label cross-agent grilled from prose or actor count. For incomplete joins, show stable ticket/map/decision with an explicit incomplete marker and no invented actor/time/category, plus validate/zoom guidance. Required v1 query controls beyond since/by should be map, provenance, and limit; ticket type is durable but optional, while cross-agent should not be filterable until typed proof exists.
